# Inconsistent formatting scheme (STR006)

Mixed separator and heading conventions within one prompt.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `str-inconsistent-delimiters` |
| Family | structural |
| Applies to | `prompt` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `auto` |
| Evidence | LLM |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

Heading and separator styles change within one prompt. Meaning-preserving format shifts move few-shot accuracy.

Bad:  ## Step 1, then **Step 2:**, then STEP 3 -.
Good: ## Step 1, ## Step 2, ## Step 3.

Not a finding when one scheme is used throughout.
